signature.name: VTask.biUnionPrepartition
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {I : BoxIntegral.Box ι} -> (π : BoxIntegral.TaggedPrepartition I) -> (πi : (J : BoxIntegral.Box ι) → BoxIntegral.Prepartition J) -> BoxIntegral.TaggedPrepartition I

conventions.statement: For a box B that is not contained in any box of π, the tag assigned by the result is the tag of a canonical fallback box from π; however, such boxes never appear as members of the result prepartition, so this junk value has no mathematical effect.
conventions.note: The tag function is total and must return a value in the ambient Icc; the fallback ensures well-typedness without affecting the mathematical content of the construction.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {I : BoxIntegral.Box ι} (π : BoxIntegral.TaggedPrepartition I) (πi : ∀ J : BoxIntegral.Box ι, BoxIntegral.Prepartition J), π.IsPartition → (∀ J ∈ π, (πi J).IsPartition) → (VTask.biUnionPrepartition π πi).IsPartition

facts.statement: ¬ (∀ {ι : Type*} {I : BoxIntegral.Box ι} (π : BoxIntegral.TaggedPrepartition I) (πi : ∀ J : BoxIntegral.Box ι, BoxIntegral.Prepartition J), π.IsHenstock → (VTask.biUnionPrepartition π πi).IsHenstock)
